extraction_notes: Main-text measured catalytic-performance data appear only in Figure 1a–c. Figure 1d and Figures 2–12 are characterization, DRIFTS/mechanistic, or DFT figures and were skipped. Figure 1a selectivity values are read from the right-hand methanol-selectivity axis; conversion bars are read from the left-hand axis. Figure 1b STY values are read from the plotted temperature series. Figure 1c is a time-on-stream plot, so only the first and last plotted points were extracted.
